@headers.core/state:
Mod Alpha — core: shared state and small helpers
The page elements every screen draws into (#app, toast, modal root), the demo
dataset (D = window.MOD_ALPHA_DATA from src/data/demo-data.js), the app-wide
UI state (current role, selected fund, filters, …) and helpers used everywhere:
money / percent formatting, HTML escaping, toast, navigation, modal, CSV export.
@headers.core/format:
Mod Alpha — core: formatting helpers
Dates (DD/MM/YYYY ⇄ Date), Indian number formats, month names, small UI
building blocks (status pills, tags, selects, toggles, avatars) shared by many screens.
@headers.core/icons:
Mod Alpha — core: icons and brand mark
Inline SVG icons: ic() = outline icons (V22_ICONS), cic() = coloured tile icons,
v22Mark() / v22BrandMark() = the Mod Alpha α logo.
@headers.core/router:
Mod Alpha — core: router
The address after # decides the screen: #/landing, #/login, #/user/<page>,
#/admin/<page>, #/pricing, #/faq. route() runs on every address change.
@headers.core/layout:
Mod Alpha — core: page layout
Top bar, sidebar navigation (user and admin menus), the signed-in page shell
and shared page parts (page headers, KPI tiles, pager, loading / empty states).
renderUser() / renderAdmin() pick the screen function for #/user/… and #/admin/….
@headers.core/events:
Mod Alpha — core: page-wide event handlers
A few click / change / input handlers cover several features at once (they were
written as one handler per screen group). Each is a start-up step so it is
registered in the original order. The selectors listed in each step say which
buttons it handles.
@headers.features/theme/theme-core:
Feature: light / dark theme — saving and applying the choice
The theme is stored in localStorage ('mod-alpha-theme') and applied to <html data-theme>.
The light "Sand" palette itself: src/features/theme/theme.js, theme-palette.js and the CSS.
@headers.shared/charts:
Shared: charts
SVG line / bar / combined charts used by the dashboard, fund pages, calculators
and the admin console, plus the hover tooltip that follows the pointer.
@headers.shared/fund-logos:
Shared: fund house logos
Shows the official AMC logo when one is listed in assets/funds/manifest.js,
otherwise a coloured monogram (two letters) for the fund house.
@headers.shared/dataset:
Shared: dataset (demo mode)
The demo runs on the bundled Excel workbook (data/mod-alpha-test-data.xlsx) or one
an admin uploads. This file validates workbooks (same rules as the API,
docs/21_test_data_excel_format.md), builds the in-memory model (funds, NAV
history, users, subscriptions, SIP dates) and keeps it in IndexedDB.
In live mode the API supplies the data instead (dataset.live.js).
@headers.features/landing/landing:
Feature: landing page (#/landing)
Hero with the orbit animation, "How Mod Alpha works" flow, features, pricing
preview, FAQ preview, the faint background animation and the anonymous
"someone just joined" toast.
@headers.features/public-pages/public-pages: Feature: public pages (#/pricing, #/faq) and the public footer
@headers.features/pricing/pricing:
Feature: pricing
The pricing cards (monthly / quarterly / yearly), prices saved by the admin
(demo: localStorage) and the billing-period switch.
@headers.features/auth/auth:
Feature: sign-in and sign-up screens (#/login, #/signup)
Email + password, mobile OTP and Google buttons, with the particle animation
behind the card. Live-mode behaviour: auth.live.js. Admin 2-code step:
admin-mfa.js. Inactivity sign-out: session-timeout.js.
@headers.features/dashboard/dashboard:
Feature: user dashboard (#/user/overview)
KPI tiles, top-funds chart, the SIP calendar with the recommended day and the
reminder card, quick what-if estimate and latest AI insights.
@headers.features/funds/funds:
Feature: explore funds (#/user/funds) and fund detail (#/user/funds/<id>)
Search, category chips, paging, fund cards; detail tabs with NAV chart and returns.
@headers.features/what-if/what-if:
Feature: what-if calculator (#/user/whatif)
"What if you had invested ₹X on date D?" — value today, CAGR and the journey chart.
@headers.features/sip/sip-compare:
Feature: Mod Alpha SIP vs traditional SIP (#/user/sip)
Compares a monthly SIP on Mod Alpha's recommended dates with the same SIP on a fixed day.
@headers.features/assistant/assistant:
Feature: Mod Alpha AI assistant (chat panel)
The floating chat button and panel with suggested questions. Demo answers are
rule-based; live answers come from POST /assistant/messages (assistant.live.js).
@headers.features/subscription/subscription:
Feature: subscription page (#/user/subscription)
Current plan, plan cards with Activate buttons, billing FAQ. Live checkout and KYC:
subscription.live.js and kyc.live.js.
@headers.features/settings/settings:
Feature: user settings (#/user/settings)
Tabs: profile, notifications (channels, SIP reminder), privacy & data, security
(change password, sign out of all devices).
@headers.features/help/help:
Feature: help & FAQ (#/user/help)
Searchable FAQ by category and the support request form.
@headers.features/admin/dashboard/admin-dashboard:
Feature: admin dashboard (#/admin/dashboard)
KPIs (users, subscribers, conversion, revenue) with period comparison, the growth
and subscription charts, the date-range picker and the recent sign-ups table.
@headers.features/admin/users/admin-users:
Feature: admin — user management (#/admin/users)
Searchable, filterable user table with paging and CSV export.
@headers.features/admin/subscriptions/admin-subsc:
Feature: admin — subscriptions (#/admin/subscriptions)
Subscription KPIs and table, plus the "Manage plans" price editor.
@headers.features/admin/sip-date/admin-sip-date:
Feature: admin — SIP date configuration (#/admin/sipdate)
Pick the month's recommended day, run the checks (weekend, holiday, past date) and publish.
@headers.features/admin/data/admin-data:
Feature: admin — data management (#/admin/data)
Upload a workbook (drag & drop), see the validation report, publish or discard,
export the live dataset, sheet rules.
@headers.features/admin/notifications/admin-notif:
Feature: admin — notifications (#/admin/notifications)
Template tiles (editor: templates-ui.js), announcements and delivery history.
@headers.features/admin/ai-models/admin-ai-models:
Feature: admin — AI models & insights (#/admin/methodology)
Model releases and their quality gates (all gates must pass before approval).
@headers.features/admin/audit/admin-audit:
Feature: admin — audit logs (#/admin/audit)
Searchable list of security- and data-relevant actions.
@headers.features/admin/settings/admin-settings:
Feature: admin — system settings (#/admin/settings)
Platform settings, the integration readiness list (what is live, mocked or still
to build) with filters and CSV export.

@live-headers.src/core/live.js:
Mod Alpha — live mode (talking to the API)
Active only when config/env.js sets API_BASE_URL (local, stage, prod). Without it
the site is the self-contained demo.
This file creates window.MA_LIVE with what every *.live.js file shares:
  API (js/api-client.js), S (signed-in user, plan, notifications, caches),
  on(selector, fn) — click handler that runs BEFORE the demo handlers and stops them,
  busy(button) — disable a button while working, fail(error) — show the error,
  date helpers isoToDmy / dmyToIso / fmt.
Load order matters: the *.live.js files run in the order listed in index.html.
@live-headers.src/shared/dataset.live.js:
Live mode — data from the API instead of the bundled workbook
Loads funds (GET /funds), the SIP dates and plans, and NAV series on demand.
@live-headers.src/features/auth/auth.live.js:
Live mode — sessions and sign-in
Loads the signed-in user (GET /auth/me), guards #/user and #/admin pages, logout /
sign out everywhere (+ sync across tabs), and the real login / sign-up / OTP /
Google / forgot-password calls. Admins continue with the 2-code step (admin-mfa.js).
@live-headers.src/features/subscription/kyc.live.js:
Live mode — KYC
The stage-only mock KYC page (#/kyc/mock) with Approve / Reject, and starting KYC
with the provider before the first paid plan.
@live-headers.src/features/subscription/subscription.l:
Live mode — checkout
Plan buttons start POST /billing/checkout (KYC first if needed). On stage a test
payment dialog confirms; with Razorpay the real checkout opens. Also cancel and invoices.
@live-headers.src/features/settings/settings.live.js:
Live mode — settings
Saves profile, notification channels, consents, password, data export / deletion
requests through the API.
@live-headers.src/core/notifications-bell.live.js:
Live mode — notifications bell
Unread count and the list from GET /me/notifications; mark as read.
@live-headers.src/features/assistant/assistant.live.js:
Live mode — AI assistant
Sends the conversation (last 10 messages) to POST /assistant/messages and shows the
reply with the daily usage; a 429 means the plan's daily limit is reached.
@live-headers.src/features/what-if/calculators.live.js:
Live mode — calculators on real NAV data
What-if (POST /calc/lumpsum) and SIP comparison (POST /calc/sip-compare).
@live-headers.src/features/public-pages/public-pages.l: Live mode — public content (FAQs, insights) from the API.
@live-headers.src/features/admin/admin.live.js:
Live mode — admin console helpers
asyncPage() (render a loading placeholder, then the page from the API), pager(),
percentage formatting. Used by every admin *.live.js file.
@live-headers.src/features/admin/dashboard/admin-dashb: Live mode — admin dashboard (GET /admin/metrics, /admin/recent) with date ranges.
@live-headers.src/features/admin/users/admin-users.liv: Live mode — admin users (GET /admin/users, CSV export, status / role changes).
@live-headers.src/features/admin/subscriptions/admin-s: Live mode — admin subscriptions and plan pricing (GET /admin/subscriptions, PUT /admin/plans/:id).
@live-headers.src/features/admin/sip-date/admin-sip-da: Live mode — SIP date configuration (validate and publish through the API).
Live mode — data management (upload, server-side validation report, publish, export).
@live-headers.src/features/admin/notifications/admin-n: Live mode — notification templates and announcements (campaigns), mock outbox.
@live-headers.src/features/admin/ai-models/admin-ai-mo: Live mode — model releases and quality gates.
@live-headers.src/features/admin/settings/admin-settin:
Live mode — system settings: platform settings, live provider status
("integrated later") and the integration backlog.
@live-headers.src/core/boot.live.js:
Live mode — boot
Adds live parts to the page shell (bell, profile), shows a spinner, loads public data
and the session in parallel, then renders the first screen.

app: #app — every screen is drawn into this element.
D: Demo dataset (funds, plans, insights, FAQs) from src/data/demo-data.js; replaced by API data in live mode.
pricingBilling: UI state shared across screens: billing period on pricing, sign-in vs sign-up, current role, selected fund / period, settings tab, signed-in user (demo), fund filters, last calculator result, admin tab.
maFundPage: Fund list paging and the sign-in method tab (email / mobile).
esc: Escape text for safe use inside HTML.
showModal: Open a modal dialog with a title and HTML body; × closes it.
exportCSV: Download rows as a CSV file.
inr: Amount in ₹ with Indian grouping, no decimals.
v22Seeded: Repeatable pseudo-random series (same input → same numbers) for illustrative demo charts.
v22ParseDate: DD/MM/YYYY (or YYYY-MM-DD) text → Date, or null.
v22DateField: Date input with a calendar button (opens the date picker).
v22AddY: Add years to a YYYY-MM-DD date.
V22_ICONS: Outline icon paths by name (search, bell, calendar, …).
v22Mark: The Mod Alpha α mark as inline SVG.
cic: Coloured tile icon (gradient background) by name and size.
v22BrandMark: Brand mark image at a given size.
logo: Mod Alpha logo link (to the landing page).
topbar: Public top bar: menu links, login / sign-up or the signed-in user.
shellLayout: Signed-in page frame: sidebar, top bar (search, bell, upgrade, profile) and the content.
renderUserPage: Draw a user screen (#/user/<page>) inside the shell.
renderAdmin: Draw an admin screen (#/admin/<page>) inside the shell.
wireCommon: Hook up buttons inside a freshly drawn screen (theme select, [data-go] links, filters, …).
V22_ADMIN_NAV: Admin sidebar menu (id, icon, label, sub-items).
v22DataOpen: Is the admin 'Data Management' sub-menu open?
sidebar: Sidebar with the role's menu, the active item highlighted, and Log out.
renderUser: renderUserPage() + keeps the cursor in the fund search box while typing.
v22Kpis: Row of small KPI tiles (icon, label, value, note).
adminNotice: Notice shown in the admin demo.
shellWithIcons: shellLayout() + new icons, upgrade / admin chip and the notifications bell.
v22NoData: Empty state (no data yet) with a hint.
v22Pager: Pager: 'Showing x–y of n' and page buttons.
shell: shellWithIcons() + removes the search box and makes the profile chip open the profile panel.
routeBase: Pick the screen for the current address.
route: routeBase() + sends the old #/user/insights address to the dashboard and opens the chat panel.
setTheme: Apply and save a theme; tells charts and the toggle (event ma:theme).
v22Chart: Line / area chart with grid, axis labels and hover points.
v22NiceMax: Round a maximum up to a nice axis value.
v22Buckets: Split a date range into chart buckets (days / weeks / months).
v22CountIn: Count rows whose date falls in a bucket.
v22AdminChart: Admin growth / subscription chart from the dataset.
v22HovSet: Show the tooltip for the hovered chart point.
v22AmcMono: Two-letter monogram for a fund house.
v22FundLogo: Fund house logo image, or the monogram.
V22_BUNDLED_URL: Bundled demo workbook URL, blank template URL and version.
V22_SCHEMA: Workbook sheets and column rules (mirrors the API).
V22D: The loaded dataset: model, report, history.
v22Mem: In-memory fallback when IndexedDB is unavailable.
v22Get: Read a value from the store.
v22ParseCell: Validate one workbook cell (dates, numbers, lists).
v22ReadSheet: Validate one sheet: header, required columns, rows, duplicates.
v22Validate: Validate a whole workbook and build the report.
v22NavAt: Index of the NAV on or before a date.
v22BuildModel: Build the model the screens use (funds with returns, NAV series, users, subscriptions, SIP dates).
v22Apply: Make a model the active dataset and redraw.
v22LoadDataset: Load the saved dataset, or the bundled workbook the first time.
v22Sample: Evenly spaced indexes for a chart.
flowLarge: The 'How Mod Alpha works' flow diagram (data → engine → date → you).
initFlowAnimation: Start the flow diagram animation when it scrolls into view.
initPublicActivityToast: Anonymous 'someone just joined / subscribed' toast from /public/activity (no personal data; nothing shown when the feed is empty).
v22HeroBase: Hero section: headline, call-to-action buttons, stat tiles and the art.
renderLanding: renderLandingBase() + features, pricing and FAQ previews, flow lines fitted to the engine card and the faint background animation.
v22InitReveal: Fade sections in as they scroll into view.
v22FitFibers: Stretch the flow lines so they reach the engine card at any width.
v22HeroArtD: Hero art: orbit scene with the phone, nodes and moving comets.
v22Hero: v22HeroBase() with the chosen hero art.
publicFooterBase: Public footer: brand, links, disclaimer, social links.
v22Faq: FAQ section with category chips and accordions.
renderPublicWithFaq: renderPublicBase() using the new FAQ section.
renderPublic: renderPublicWithFaq() without the old duplicate disclaimers.
publicFooter: publicFooterWithSocial() with the brand mark column.
v22Billing: Selected billing period on the pricing cards.
pricingSection: Pricing cards for Free / Pro / Premium.
v22AnimatePrice: Animate the price when the billing period changes.
v22PlanPrice: Price of a plan for a billing period (yearly = 20 % off unless set).
renderAuthForm: Sign-in / sign-up card (email or mobile tab, password, social buttons).
renderAuth: renderAuthForm() + the particle animation behind the card.
v22AuthAnim: Particle animation on a canvas (theme-aware; waves optional).
v22DashPeriod: Selected period on the dashboard chart.
v22CalMonth: Month shown in the SIP calendar.
v22PickDay: Day the user picked in the calendar.
v22ReminderState: Current reminder choice (Mod Alpha date or custom).
v22ReminderCard: Reminder card next to the calendar (Set Reminder).
v22CalFooter: Calendar legend and alternative good days.
v22Calendar: Month calendar with the recommended day highlighted.
v22EstBars: Mod Alpha vs traditional SIP bars.
v22QuickCalc: Run the quick what-if on the dashboard.
v22DashChart: Top-funds cumulative return chart from the dataset (falls back to the sample).
v22SipFor: Recommended SIP date for a month.
v22UserKpis: KPI tiles from the dataset (falls back to the sample).
v22Chip: Selected category chip and page on Explore Funds.
fundExplorer: Explore Funds screen: search, chips, sort, cards, pager.
v22DetailPeriod: Selected period on the fund detail chart.
fundTab: Fund detail tab content (overview, returns, risk).
v22DetailChart: NAV chart from the dataset (falls back to the sample).
V22_LUMP_CAGR: Illustrative yearly returns per fund for the demo calculator.
v22Lump: Value of a lump sum after some years.
v22SolveRate: CAGR from start and end values.
runCalc: Run the calculation and redraw the result.
V22_R_MOD: Illustrative monthly returns: Mod Alpha dates vs fixed date.
v22Sip: Future value of a monthly SIP for both strategies.
insightsPage: AI insights page (old address; now opens the chat panel).
answerAI: Demo answer for an insights question.
V22_SUB_FAQ: Billing FAQ on the subscription page.
subscriptionPage: Subscription screen: current plan, plan cards, billing FAQ.
helpPage: Help & FAQ screen with the support form.
v22AdminKpi: Admin KPI tile with period comparison.
v22MonthStats: Users / subscriptions / revenue for a period from the dataset.
v22HandleFile: Read and validate a dropped / chosen workbook.
v22ReportHTML: Validation report (per sheet: rows, errors, warnings).
v22IssuesCsv: Download the validation issues as CSV.
v22ExportDataset: Download the active dataset as a workbook.
adminSettings: System settings screen: platform settings and integration readiness.
v22IntCsv: Download the integration list as CSV.
